cfg.kineticitem.prot.global.damage.immun: §eWhen enabled, listed damage sources will not hurt any dropped item
§eSupports single damage IDs like minecraft:player_explosion and damage tags like #minecraft:is_fire
cfg.kineticitem.prot.global.direct.entit: §eWhen enabled, dropped items will ignore direct damage caused by listed entities
§eSupports single entity IDs like tacz:bullet and entity tags like #forge:bullets
cfg.kineticitem.prot.list.tooltip: §eFormat: Identifier;FireImmune;ExplosionImmune;Glowing;NoGravity. §aIdentifiers support item IDs, #tags, @mods, and optional NBT after an item ID; the four flags must be true or false.
cfg.kineticitem.prot.void_salvage.toolti: When enabled, protected items falling into the void will teleport to the nearest safe ground or world spawn.
cfg.kineticitem.protection.apply_notice: Damage-immunity rules take effect immediately after saving; already dropped items are not retroactively reset.
gui.kineticitem.banitem.title: §lBanned Items Management
gui.kineticitem.banitem.tooltip.btn.rule: Ban or unban the currently searched tag/mod.
gui.kineticitem.banitem.tooltip.merge_ta: §bThe target item has %s tags. Click to show only items related to those tags.
§cThe target item has no tags available for filtering.
gui.kineticitem.banitem.tooltip.protecte: §cThis item is protected by the mod and cannot be banned
gui.kineticitem.banitem.tooltip.right_un: §cRight to unban this rule and reload cache
tip.kineticitem.void_placeholder.warning: §c§lThis item has been banned or replaced
cfg.kineticitem.protection.description: §aDropped-item protection, damage immunity, and dedicated item rules can be configured here without opening config files manually. §eServer settings can only be saved by administrators.
cfg.kineticitem.prot.enable.tooltip: §aMaster switch for custom dropped-item protection rules, including fire, explosion, glowing, and no-gravity properties.
cfg.kineticitem.editors.title: §eDedicated Item Rule Editors
cfg.kineticitem.editors.description: §aItem banning and item merging use dedicated visual editors. §eOpening and saving are revalidated by the server for administrator permission.
cfg.kineticitem.editor.banitem.tooltip: §aEdit item ban and replacement rules used by natural generation and structures.
cfg.kineticitem.editor.mergeitem.tooltip: §aEdit canonical items and equivalence merge rules. The server validates configuration on save.
gui.kineticitem.module.name: §bKineticItem
gui.kineticitem.module.tooltip: §aManages item protection, item banning, item replacement, and item merging rules.
gui.kineticitem.protection_editor.title: §eItem Protection Rule Editor
gui.kineticitem.protection_editor.hint: §eLeft-click to select a rule, right-click to remove it; new rules can use an item, tag, or mod.
msg.kineticitem.protection_editor.invali: §cInvalid selection; the protection rule could not be added.
